proposition.claim:
General equality of determinant zero order and geometric kernel dimension is false for the defined Schottky transfer family.

Mirrored stopping set need not partition for all0<tau<L_gamma; suffix definition is inconsistent with prefix-cylinder proof.

Auxiliary norm, word index, epsilon scope and threshold require local corrections.
